summary: Independent source and local SQL review of API WILD-only welcome claim, bounded worker entrypoint and modern Supabase secret header support. No findings in changed scope.
review: New claim is service-role-only, rejects customer JWT authority, uses qualified names with empty search_path, and validates finite batch.
SQL brand filter applies before cleanup, locking, claiming and daily attempt accounting. AARO rows are byte-for-byte unchanged in local regression.
Shared ten-attempt UTC budget and per-event attempts/idempotency window are unchanged; processing/ambiguous events are not reclaimed.
API WILD entrypoint forces brand scope and one-job batch. Entire received batch is validated before any provider send; modern secret key is sent in apikey only.
Installation creates only a function/grant; no row is enqueued or sent and shared existing RPC is preserved. CLI logs counters/sanitized errors only.
limitations: Offline synthetic transport and single-connection PGlite only; not independent-session PostgreSQL contention proof.
No live migration, queue claim, email send, cron activation or inbox acceptance was performed by reviewer.

alignmentReview.note: Coordinator independently re-reviewed worker public_status changes moving privilege to private apiwild_finance helper with public invoker wrapper and catalog rights assertions. No findings.
